newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RONALDO LEADS BARCELONA TO 4-0 ROUT OF LAS PALMAS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO LEADS BARCELONA TO 4-0 ROUT OF LAS PALMAS.

text.p: Ronaldo virtually guaranteed Barcelona a place in the Spanish Cup final after leading his side to a 4-0 rout of second division Las Palmas in the first leg of their semifinal on Wednesday.
Las Palmas had Barcelona on the ropes until just before the break when Ronaldo was brought down in the penalty area.
The Brazilian had no problems converting the penalty and scored again in the second half. Goals by Juan Pizzi and Ivan de la Pena rounded off a fine night for Bobby Robson's team.
But it was not all good news for Barcelona. International defender Sergi Barjuan fractured a bone in his arm and could be out for a month.
Barcelona's most likely opponents in the final are Real Betis, 1-0 winners over Celta Vigo in the other semifinal, first leg played on Tuesday.
